_meta.description: Default financial assumptions for the Deal Economics Copilot. The engine reads a populated DealAssumptions; nothing here is hardcoded in engine code. Every entry carries value + basis_class (maps to ProvenanceClass) + note + as_of so the UI/Excel layer can render provenance badges and staleness.

pue.note: Typical hyperscaler data-center power-usage-effectiveness; industry range 1.1-1.5.

wacc.note: Discount rate for NPV. Corporate WACC placeholder; confirm with Treasury per deal.

opex_allocation_pct.note: Allocated operating expense as a fraction of net revenue; deal-desk default.

supplier_payment_dpo_days.note: Days payable outstanding — standard supplier net-60 terms. Sets the DPO lag (cash OUT) on COGS and opex. Confirm with Procurement.

inventory_lead_months.note: Months that GPU/HBM inventory cash is funded ahead of shipment (leading-edge component lead time). One-number simplification, not a supply-chain model; nets against DPO into the COGS cash lag. Confirm with Operations.

unit_cogs_usd.note: Blended per-unit cost of goods sold; overridden per generation when a COGS curve is supplied. Confirm with cost accounting.

payment_terms_dso_map.note: Maps recognized payment terms to days-sales-outstanding for the cash view.

default_tranche_vest_probabilities.note: Declining vest probability by warrant tranche (later milestones less certain). Consumed by Phase 4 warrant economics.

current_stock_price_usd.note: market price as of 2026-06-11, update before warrant analysis

assumed_volatility.note: Annualized equity volatility for the optional Black-Scholes warrant mode (illustrative).

shares_outstanding.note: Seller shares outstanding (~1.618B), for warrant dilution %. Refresh from latest 10-Q before relying on dilution.

risk_free_rate.note: Risk-free rate for the illustrative Black-Scholes warrant mode only.

base_asp_usd.note: Per-unit base average selling price for this generation.

cogs_curve_per_year_usd.note: Per-year unit COGS, learning-curve decline. Consumed by multi-gen modeling (deferred P1).

supply_capacity_per_quarter_units.note: Assumed quarterly supply ceiling for the feasibility check (deferred P1).
